name: Human Activity Radar Challenge
description: A challenge-style benchmark based on the 'Radar Signatures of Human Activities' dataset for evaluating human activity recognition algorithms from radar signals.
domain: radar / signal processing / human activity recognition
reputation: A domain-specific challenge used within the radar/signal-processing community; adoption is moderate among researchers working on radar-based human activity recognition.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark relying on radar signal processing; results can be sensitive to sensor setup, preprocessing, and dataset size; potential domain shift across environments and subjects.
